states.text:
Requirements of src/accounts/password-policy.mjs after stage 3:
- the minimum password length is 11 characters
- the maximum password length is 32 characters
- a password must contain a digit
- a password must contain an uppercase letter
- a password must contain a symbol
- the username rule is off
- the list of banned words is monkey, sunshine and welcome
